summary: Iran launched two ballistic missiles toward the UAE, both falling into the sea, triggering air defense activations and shelter alerts in Dubai. The UAE subsequently halted all trade and financial transactions with Iran, its second-largest trading partner. Israel conducted airstrikes in Gaza targeting Hamas commanders and in Syria to prevent Turkish deployment near Aleppo, while the IRGC seized a Chinese oil tanker in the Strait of Hormuz.
key_points: Iran fired two ballistic missiles at the UAE, both landing in the sea, prompting UAE air defense activation and seek-shelter alerts in Dubai. (Source: @shin_persian/9019, @shin_persian/9009, @New_security8200/203355)
The UAE announced a complete halt to trade, commercial exchanges, and financial transactions with Iran, citing recent regional escalations. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/6384)

Israeli airstrikes in Gaza's Shati area targeted Hamas commanders planning attacks; a separate strike near Gaza City port hit a cafe, killing six and wounding ten according to Palestinian media. (Source: @amitsegal/64012, @manniefabian/58989)
Israel struck in Syria to enforce a security status quo, warning Syria against allowing Turkish forces to deploy at an airbase near Aleppo. (Source: @yediotnews25/134078)
The IRGC intercepted the Chinese oil tanker 'Hista' after it attempted to transit the Strait of Hormuz via an unauthorized Omani route. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/385577)
Iran's Chief of Staff warned Persian Gulf states hosting US military assets, especially tanker aircraft, that their cooperation is under surveillance. (Source: @naya_foriraq/88138)

Iranian officials reportedly prepared contingency plans to attack US military targets in Europe (Bulgaria, Cyprus) and undersea cables in the Strait of Hormuz if the US escalated. (Source: @asafroz/52554)
IDF reservist Battalion 8207 began its sixth deployment cycle since October 7, now operating in Syria under Brigade 474. (Source: @idf_telegram/24921)

sections.executive_summary: Iran launched two ballistic missiles toward the UAE, both falling into the sea, triggering air defense activations and shelter alerts in Dubai. The UAE subsequently halted all trade and financial transactions with Iran, its second-largest trading partner. Israel conducted airstrikes in Gaza targeting Hamas commanders and in Syria to prevent Turkish deployment near Aleppo, while the IRGC seized a Chinese oil tanker in the Strait of Hormuz.

points: Iran launched two ballistic missiles toward the UAE at 1705Z; both fell into the sea, according to the UAE Ministry of Defense. The attack followed a 1457Z seek-shelter alert in Dubai and 1502Z air defense activation across the Persian Gulf. (Source: @shin_persian/9019, @shin_persian/9009, @New_security8200/203355)

Iran's Chief of Staff, Major General Mohammad Bagheri, warned southern Persian Gulf states that hosting US military aircraft — particularly tankers — at regional bases does not escape Iranian surveillance, implying retaliation if those assets are used against Iran. (Source: @naya_foriraq/88138)

Sources close to the Tehran regime told the Financial Times that Iran prepared to strike US military targets in Southeast Europe, including Bulgaria's Bezmer airbase (approved for US tanker use) and Cyprus (previously targeted by a drone), and to sever undersea fiber-optic cables in the Strait of Hormuz if the US escalated. (Source: @asafroz/52554)

IRGC naval forces seized the Chinese VLCC 'Hista' after it attempted to cross the Strait of Hormuz via an Omani-route corridor deemed unauthorized, returning it to Iranian custody. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/385577)

Iranian Parliament Speaker Mohammad Bagher Qalibaf visited Baghdad and Karbala, meeting Iraqi leaders and attending Arbaeen ceremonies for Qassem Soleimani and Abu Mahdi al-Muhandis, declaring the Iran-Iraq resistance axis 'global' and pledging continued sacrifice. (Source: @naya_foriraq/88143, @naya_foriraq/88138, @naya_foriraq/88141, @naya_foriraq/88142, @rasedal3ado138e/385578)
Syria's new authorities acknowledged possession of nuclear material remaining from the Assad era, asserting a 'right to develop a civilian nuclear program.' (Source: @amitsegal/64008)
An Iranian TV expert publicly called for mining US coastlines, reflecting hardline rhetoric advocating asymmetric retaliation against the American homeland. (Source: @kianmeli1/90925)

The IDF struck multiple Hamas commanders in the Shati area of northern Gaza who were planning imminent attacks against Israeli forces operating in the Strip, using a precise aerial strike. (Source: @amitsegal/64012)

A separate Israeli strike near the Gaza City port targeted a cafe, killing six and wounding ten according to Palestinian media; the IDF confirmed the target was Hamas commanders planning attacks. (Source: @manniefabian/58989)

Israel's Prime Minister's Office stated that Syria agreed to maintain a security status quo but violated it by allowing Turkish forces to deploy at an airbase near Aleppo; Israel warned repeatedly, then struck to enforce the agreement. (Source: @yediotnews25/134078, @inon_yttach/9878, @rodast_omiddana/79487)

Reservist Battalion 8207, veterans of October 7 and deep Lebanon operations, began its sixth mobilization cycle, now deployed in Syria under Brigade 474, training for extreme scenarios including convergence under fire and NBC operations. (Source: @idf_telegram/24921)
Israeli forces abducted Palestinian journalist Abdul Rahman Hassan during a home raid on Al-Saff Street in central Bethlehem, West Bank. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/385573)
An Israeli couple with a one-year-old child entered Jericho (Area A) for shopping and required police extraction; they were questioned under caution. (Source: @pkpoi/143647)

The Attorney General declared that 80% of ultra-Orthodox men still evade conscription despite increased recruitment, urging expanded economic enforcement and proactive police/IDF arrest operations against evaders. (Source: @yediotnews25/134075, @pkpoi/143657)

Israeli airstrike in Gaza's Shati refugee camp targeted Hamas commanders planning attacks on IDF forces; the military described it as a precise aerial strike to remove the threat. (Source: @amitsegal/64012)

sections.threat_assessment: Iran has demonstrated both the capability and willingness to launch ballistic missiles at Gulf states, with two missiles reaching UAE airspace before falling into the sea. This marks a significant escalation in direct Iranian kinetic action against a Gulf Cooperation Council member. Concurrently, Iranian leadership has signaled readiness to expand targeting to US military infrastructure in Europe (Bulgaria, Cyprus) and critical undersea cables in the Strait of Hormuz, indicating a potential shift to multi-theater asymmetric warfare. Israel continues offensive operations in Gaza and Syria, now explicitly targeting Turkish-linked deployments near Aleppo, risking friction with a NATO member. The IRGC's seizure of a Chinese tanker in the Strait of Hormuz underscores Iranian willingness to disrupt global energy transit. The convergence of these vectors — Iranian missile strikes on Gulf states, Israeli strikes on Turkish positions in Syria, and threats to European and maritime targets — suggests a high probability of further escalation within weeks.
sections.regional_response: The UAE responded to the Iranian missile attack by activating air defenses, issuing civilian shelter alerts, and imposing a total trade and financial embargo on Iran, its second-largest trading partner — a major economic decoupling step. Gulf states on the southern Persian Gulf coast have been put on explicit notice by Iran's Chief of Staff regarding hosting US tanker aircraft, creating a dilemma for countries like the UAE, Qatar, and Bahrain that host US bases. France announced the expulsion of two Iranian diplomats, signaling European alignment with pressure on Tehran. Iraq's Kurdistan region continues to mediate US-Iran backchannel talks via Nechirvan Barzani, who has met IRGC Quds Force commander Ismail Qaani in Baghdad. Syria's new authorities have admitted to possessing legacy nuclear material and asserted a right to a civilian nuclear program, inviting international scrutiny. No collective GCC or Arab League response was reported in the messages.
sections.intelligence_notes: The Iranian missile launch at the UAE appears calibrated — two ballistic missiles that fell harmlessly into the sea — suggesting a signaling operation rather than a maximum-effect strike, possibly to demonstrate reach without triggering massive retaliation. The UAE's immediate total trade halt indicates a pre-determined threshold for economic response. Israel's strike in Syria targeting Turkish deployment near Aleppo reveals a red line against Turkish military entrenchment south of the Euphrates, likely coordinated with Russian tacit acceptance. The IRGC's tanker seizure in the Strait of Hormuz via an 'unauthorized Omani route' suggests Iran is enforcing new maritime transit rules. The Financial Times report on Iranian contingency plans for European targets and undersea cables, if accurate, indicates advanced operational planning for horizontal escalation. Qalibaf's high-profile Iraq visit, including Arbaeen participation, reinforces the political-military integration of the 'Resistance Axis' across the Iran-Iraq-Syria-Lebanon corridor. The IDF's sixth mobilization of Battalion 8207 in Syria signals sustained Israeli operational commitment to the Syrian theater beyond the Lebanon ceasefire.
